summary: Quantum BioPharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, reporting its Q2 2026 financial results via press release. The filing details cash and digital assets of approximately US$9.5 million (up from US$4.1 million at year-end 2025), improved working capital of US$1.66 million, and confirmation that liquidity funds operations to October 2027. It also notes FDA approval for the Lucid-MS Phase 2 trial. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. No transaction, tender, restructuring, or activist event is disclosed; it is a standard periodic financial update.
